name: Shis
source:
Firstborn princess of Kujyuri, and [url=/c37790]Rulutieh's[/url] older sister. Strong-willed and regal, she left her home for the sake of a political marriage, but returned after her suitor was found wanting. She loves [url=/c37790]Rulutieh[/url], and will do anything to protect her—sometimes to the point of stifling her.

[From [url=http://atlus.com/uta/truth/home.html]official site[/url]]
